content.title: Browse the bouquet catalogue and prices
content.description: A visitor browses the bouquet catalogue, sees the price of every bouquet before deciding whether to add anything to the basket, and can do that browsing on a phone so ordering is possible outside staffed shop hours.
content.value: Helps customers self-serve product discovery and purchase decisions without calling or messaging the shop.
criteria: the catalogue shows the price of every bouquet before basket addition
catalogue browsing works on a phone
